instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.move: Move the avatar with arrow keys or WASD
instructions.bounce: If you hit an obstacle or wall, you bounce back
instructions.noCount: Bouncing does not count as a move
instructions.enemies: Enemies chase you 2 steps per turn
instructions.traps: Traps stun whoever steps on them for 3 turns
instructions.goal: Reach the goal before they catch you
credits.title: Credits
instructions.controlsMove: Arrow keys or WASD to move
instructions.rule2: If you try to move into an obstacle or wall, the avatar bounces visually and returns to its cell. The move is cancelled and doesn't count as a turn.
instructions.objGoal: Goal: reach this cell to complete the screen and advance.
instructions.rule7: The goal is to reach the exit before an enemy catches you. If an enemy reaches your cell, you lose.
instructions.rule3: Every time you move, enemies also move. Each enemy takes 2 steps per turn and always chases you: it first tries to close in horizontally, then vertically.
instructions.objKey: Key: pick it up to open locks and unlock the path.
instructions.objEnemy: Enemy: chases you every turn. Takes 2 steps, horizontal first. If it reaches you, you lose.
instructions.rule4: Enemies always move every turn. They only stop if stunned by a trap (3 turns). There are no static enemies.
instructions.objObstacle: Obstacle: blocks the way. On impact, the avatar bounces and you don't spend a turn.
instructions.rule5: Traps stun for 3 turns whoever steps on them, whether player or enemy. While stunned you cannot move. While an enemy is stunned, it doesn't move.
instructions.objTrap: Trap: stuns for 3 turns whoever steps on it. Affects players and enemies equally.
instructions.rule6: Each screen can have a maximum of 3 enemies. At the start of a level, no cell can have more than one element.
instructions.objAvatar: Avatar: your character. Move with arrows or WASD. Only moves horizontally and vertically.
instructions.rule1: The avatar only moves in 4 orthogonal directions: up, down, left and right. Diagonal movement is forbidden.
exit.title: See you soon
